_comment: Field corrections to the ACO 2022 Darwin Core archive (data/sources/aco.json), applied by common.checklist() for every step that reads the list. Key = normalised ACO scientific name. Grallaria saturata / G. saltuensis: the archive's vernacularName values are swapped (saturata = Equatorial Antpitta, saltuensis = Perijá Antpitta, as in SACC and eBird/Clements).
